summary_1line: Sauti begins the tale of Astika: the ascetic Jaratkaru meets his endangered ancestors, who urge him to marry and produce a son to save their lineage.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Jaratkaru beholds his ancestors hanging head-down over a dark pit, suspended by a fraying grass rope gnawed by a rat.
The austere wanderer Jaratkaru, thin and radiant from penance, stands in a forest clearing speaking solemnly to the spirits of his suspended ancestors.
